text:
Ana: Quick sync 1: webinar landing needs final SEO pass before we blast invites. Need canonical, keyword list, redirects, schema, and inbound tagging. Who can own what?

Carlos: I can own canonical + meta. Suggest canonical: /webinars/inference-playbook. Meta title draft: "Inference Playbook: Latency, Cost, and Serving Patterns | Redwood". Meta desc short: "Benchmarks and tactics to optimize LLM inference cost and latency. Register for the webinar."

Lina: KW shortlist: primary: ["inference cost", "LLM serving best practices", "reduce model latency"]; long-tail: ["webinar on inference optimizations", "inference batching webinar"]. I'll add these into the page H1/H2s and alt text for images.

Owen: Redirects: I'll deploy a Netlify PR with 1:1 301s and preserve query params. Draft map:
```
/old-inference-webinar    /webinars/inference-playbook    301
/webinar-2025-inference   /webinars/inference-playbook    301
/docs/old-inference-guide /docs/inference/getting-started   301
```
I will avoid chains and run a quick redirect-checker.

Ana: Schema: Event + VideoObject + FAQ. Keep JSON-LD minimal. Sample event props: name, startDate, location (VirtualLocation), url. Add FAQ item for "Will there be a recording?" and "Is this relevant for enterprise/private deployment?".

Carlos: Inbound routing: UTM campaign = webinar_inference_playbook_may. All forms should tag source=webinar and campaign=webinar_inference_playbook_may. HubSpot workflow: tag attendees as webinar_playbook_attended and route qualified leads to AE queue.

Lina: Internal links: add CTAs from /docs/inference/getting-started, /blog/serving-costs, and /benchmarks/latency to the webinar. Use anchor text "inference playbook webinar". Add rel=canonical on any paginated/tag duplicates.

SEO Bot: Scheduled crawl at 2016668400. Will report 404s, redirect chains >1 hop, and schema validation failures.

Owen: I'll open PR by 11:30 PT with redirects + Netlify preview. Ping @Ana for approval.

Ana: Thanks team 1: once PR + schema pass, proceed with email send.
